verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents its own bulk capabilities. The GitHub README says it can scrape thousands of URLs asynchronously and crawl entire sites. The webhooks docs name 'batch scrape' as a job type that reports start, progress and completion events. However, the evidence is only one-line mentions, so the depth of bulk support is unproven. missing for 10: dedicated batch-scrape docs covering limits, concurrency and error handling; bulk operations beyond scraping, such as batch extract or agent jobs across many items; independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk runs at scale.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Get notified the moment a crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent job, or monitor check starts, progresses, or finishes.
Crawl an entire website and get content from all pages.
